rows.text: A notebook of quizzes that once circulated on a small scale on the Herta Space Station. Parts of it were copied from Herta's childhood notebook. Just opening it will leave the reader stunned with incomprehensible numbers and formulas and inflict prolonged self-doubt. It's rumored that any researcher who can independently solve a single question in the book will receive the chance to converse face-to-face with the great Madam Herta. Though no one had been able to verify that rumor to date, this book was still sold out in seconds thanks to the fans and became a legendary collector's tome that has gone out of print.
